reviews.text: Friendly and professional. The best groomers I have ever used for my little Frank. Highly recommended
Lynn and Mark are superb. They really look after both of my dogs every time I take them. Thanks. Kam
Such lovely genuine people. They look after our Cocker spaniel Maggie with such care and attention. Thank you so much. Would highly recommend.

A very professional and friendly service, time and care taken to complete the job.
Thanks Mark and Lynn

I've being coming here for years.

Lynn and Mark are the best. My dog always comes out a million dollars.

They are so compassionate and genuinely pursue a friendship with their customers.

I would give a six star if I could.

We took our puppy Minnie who is 4 and half months old for her first proper groom. She has come out smelling lovely and looks a different dog. We won't be going elsewhere in the future. They were very friendly and Minnie was very happy being left with them. Would recommend them to anybody 10 out 10 from us.

After a worrying first groom else where. I decided to try collar and tie. So happy I did. Such lovely people genuinely cared about my pups. Very pleased with their grooms smelt and looked beautiful. Trixie and Jude will definitely be back. 😃 …
